title: 第一卷 第12章 要不咱俩谈恋爱吧
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
来到礁石滩。

    李华站在高处，左右观望。

    没看到张春妮。

    李华说道：“阿青，来根烟。”

    抽完。

    再来一根。

    抽完后，还是不见张春妮的人影，他问道：“阿青，几点了？”

    阿青看了看电子表。

    他说道：“七点十五分。”

    李华“哦”了一声，又点着一根香烟，正准备去白沙村去找张春妮的时候，一个高挑纤瘦的身影，慌慌张张的从防浪堤跑下来。

    洗到发白的短袖长裤，一双墨绿色的胶鞋，奔跑过来，用红色的塑料绳扎成低马尾甩来甩去。

    偶尔抬头显露的绝美侧颜，不是张春妮，又是谁。

    她大概也知道迟到了，所以跑的很快。

    李华脸色一变。

    赶紧喊了一嗓子，让她停下！

    防浪堤下面，礁石林立。

    走路都得小心，更不要说跑了，稍不注意，万一滑倒摔跤，可不得了。

    尤其是礁石上挂满了被挖去肉的海蛎壳。

    这些可危险的很。

    相当锋利。

    稍不注意，一划就是一道口子。

    万一伤口感染，更是会要命。

    他们这边，在这里丢命的不是没有。

    听到喊声，张春妮下意识的抬头。

    看到李华抬手指着她，脸色还很凶的喊让她站住，吓得赶紧停下来，都不敢动了。

    李华大步走过去。

    到了跟前。

    “你胆子真大，在这边都敢跑！”

    “我着急……我……迟到了。”张春妮不敢抬头看李华，低着头，磕磕巴巴的解释：“对不起……我奶生病，我送她打针，耽误了时间。”

    “哦，走吧。”

    李华应了一声，前面的礁石有些陡峭，他说道：“这边不好走，我拉着你。”

    张春妮后退了一步，躲开他的手，慌张的说道：“不……不用。”

    “我……我……我自己走。”

    李华盯着她看，说道：“你觉得我是想占你便宜吗？”

    张春妮不吭声。

    李华声音拔高几度：“看起来你真能是这么想的啊。”

    张春妮都要哭了。

    她心里很是不安，担心实话实说，会被李华打。

    可不说，看起来也要被打。
content_en:
Arrive at the reef beach.

    Li Hua stood at a high place and looked around.

    I didn’t see Zhang Chunni.

    Li Hua said: "Ah Qing, let's have a cigarette."

    Finished.

    One more.

    After finishing smoking, there was still no sign of Zhang Chunni. He asked, "Ah Qing, what time is it?"

    Ah Qing looked at the electronic watch.

    He said, "Seven-fifteen."

    Li Hua said "Oh" and lit another cigarette. When he was about to go to Baisha Village to find Zhang Chuni, a tall and slender figure ran down the breakwater in a panic.

    She ran over wearing short-sleeved trousers that turned white after washing, and a pair of dark green rubber shoes, tying a red plastic rope into a low ponytail and swinging it around.

    The beautiful profile that is revealed when she occasionally raises her head is not Zhang Chunni, but who else.

    She probably knew she was late, so she ran quickly.

    Li Hua's expression changed.

    He quickly shouted and asked her to stop!

    Below the breakwater, there are many rocks.

    You have to be careful when walking, let alone running. If you don't pay attention, it will be serious if you slip and fall.

    In particular, the rocks are covered with oyster shells with their flesh removed.

    These can be very dangerous.

    Pretty sharp.

    If you don't pay attention, a cut will appear in one stroke.

    If the wound becomes infected, it can be fatal.

    On their side, there are not many people who have lost their lives here.

    Hearing the shouting, Zhang Chunni subconsciously raised her head.

    When she saw Li Hua raising his finger and pointing at her, shouting at her to stop with a fierce look on his face, he was so frightened that he stopped quickly and didn't dare to move.

    Li Hua strode over.

    Arrived.

    "You are so brave, you dare to run here!"

    "I'm anxious... I'm... late." Zhang Chuni didn't dare to look up at Li Hua, lowered her head, and stumbled to explain: "I'm sorry... my mother was sick, so I gave her an injection, which wasted time."

    "Oh, let's go."

    Li Hua responded. The rocks in front were a bit steep and he said, "It's not easy to walk here. I'll hold you."

    Zhang Chuni took a step back, avoided his hand, and said in a panic: "No... no need."

    "I...I...I'll go on my own."

    Li Hua stared at her and said, "Do you think I want to take advantage of you?"

    Zhang Chunni remained silent.

    Li Hua's voice rose several times: "It seems like you really think so."

    Zhang Chunni was about to cry.

    She felt very uneasy, worried that if she told the truth, she would be beaten by Li Hua.

    Not to mention, it looked like he was about to be beaten.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 12 How about we fall in love?
